reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

A lightweight and hydrating sunscreen that absorbs quickly and leaves a beautiful healthy glow on the skin. It doesn't sting my eyes and feels comfortable throughout the day. I think it can work well for most skin types.
reviews.zh:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

一款輕盈、補水嘅防曬，吸收快，令皮膚有好健康嘅光澤。唔會刺痛我嘅眼睛，成日都感覺舒服。我覺得大部分膚質都會用得好好。

reviews.text:
The beplain Sunmuse Moisture Sunscreen is genuinely one of the most comfortable sunscreens I’ve used. The texture is lightweight but still moisturizing, and it sinks into the skin quickly without leaving any white cast or greasy film.

My skin feels calm, hydrated, and protected throughout the day. It doesn’t sting my eyes and doesn’t leave that heavy sunscreen feeling — it’s more like applying a light moisturizer. Perfect for daily use, especially if your skin gets easily irritated or dry.
reviews.zh:
beplain Sunmuse Moisture Sunscreen 真係我用過最舒服嘅防曬之一。質地輕盈但仍然保濕，好快滲入皮膚，唔會留白或者油膜。

一日到晚，我嘅皮膚都感覺平靜、水潤、受到保護。唔會刺痛眼睛，亦唔會有嗰種厚重嘅防曬感覺——更似塗咗一款輕盈嘅保濕霜。日常使用非常好，尤其係如果你皮膚容易受刺激或者乾燥。

reviews.text: Light, non-greasy, and absorbs fast! I wear it every day under my makeup and it doesn’t leave a white cast.Perfect for no-makeup days — gives a little color and makes my skin look smooth and even.Great for sensitive skin! It feels gentle and doesn’t cause any breakouts or irritation.
reviews.zh: 輕盈、唔油膩，吸收快！我每日化妝底下都用，佢唔會留白。好啱唔化妝嘅日子——會帶少少色澤，令皮膚睇落更加幼滑、均勻。啱敏感皮膚！感覺溫和，唔會引起任何爆痘或者刺激。

reviews.text: i've been using this beplain sunscreen for years. yes, it's THAT good! has no smell, so it's suitable for people who are sensitive to fragrances. the texture is smooth and silky, glides on easily and works well under makeup. feels like you're applying normal face cream. i could go on and on about how much i love this sunscreen.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款 beplain 防曬好多年。係呀，就係咁好！冇任何味道，所以啱對香味敏感嘅人用。質地幼滑絲滑，推開好容易，化妝底下都好好用。塗落去感覺好似塗緊普通面霜咁。我可以一直講我有幾鍾意呢款防曬。

reviews.text: the formula of this sunscreen is so awesome, I have oily t zone and dry skin on my cheeks and this is so great for that. does not sting my eyes when I sweat or make my skin super red, I am quite tan and find this melts beautifully into the skin. the physical version of this sunscreen is also good but I prefer this one by far!!! I have gone through so many bottles and just purchased 3 more for my restock
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬嘅配方好正，我嘅 T 字部位會油，面頰就乾，所以好啱。出汗嗰時唔會刺痛我嘅眼睛，亦唔會令皮膚超級紅。我皮膚都幾曬黑，我覺得佢滲入皮膚嘅效果好漂亮。呢款防曬嘅物理版本都好，但係我遠遠都係鍾意呢款多啲！！！我用咗好多樽，啱啱再買咗 3 樽補貨。

reviews.text: It’s a chemical sunscreen with a glowy finish that sadly contains T-Butyl Alcohol, which tends to dry my skin out. It has a slight brightening effect from Tinosorb M, so it might leave a white cast on deeper skin tones.
reviews.zh: 呢款係化學防曬，妝感有光澤，但可惜含有叔丁醇（T-Butyl Alcohol），佢容易令我嘅皮膚乾燥。佢含有 Tinosorb M，有少少提亮效果，所以喺較深膚色嘅皮膚上可能會留白。

reviews.text: I have tried many korean & japanese spfs and yet I have to say that the beplain one is one of my absolute favorites!! It is super lightweight & absorbes into the skin really fast. You do not have a tacky feeling or anything. You should really give it a try!
reviews.zh: 我試過好多韓國同日本嘅防曬，但係我一定要講，beplain 嗰款係我最鍾意嘅其中一款！！佢超輕盈，吸收快到不得了。唔會有黏手嘅感覺或者乜嘢。你真係要試吓！

reviews.text: Extremely lightweight and not sticky at all, even after three applications. It settles rather matte and not once has my hair stuck to my face. My skin just looks amazing with this sunscreen and I have experienced no pilling at all.
reviews.zh: 超級輕盈，就算塗咗三次都完全唔黏。乾咗之後會比較啞光，而且我嘅頭髮從來冇黏喺面上。用呢款防曬，我嘅皮膚睇落好靚，完全冇起搓。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
